# Tessa Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hollowmere  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Tessa is a plump, rotund six-year-old child with red, curly hair and hazel eyes. She often falls asleep with her eyes shut tight in a crinkled, amusing manner.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c19 P9](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0009)_

## Personality

Tessa possesses a sensitive six-year-old pride. She can easily lose her nerve when faced with unexpected threats.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_

## Traits

- plump  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c19 P9](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0009)</sub>
- easily frightened  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>
- proud  <sub>[v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>

## History

Tessa lived at Hollowmere as the youngest of the children there. On one occasion, while carrying a basket of berries picked by Tabitha, she was charged at and chased by Mary Stubbs wielding a giant dried codfish. Frightened and overwhelmed by the strange ordeal, Tessa dropped her basket, spilling the berries into the dusty road as she fled screaming. After Mary fled from the scene, Miss Winifred found Tessa crying and miserable, with her hat, dress, and slippers ruined, and carried her back to the house. Later, Tessa was seen studying her primer on the veranda alongside Harcourt while Tabitha knitted.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c26 P8](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0008)_
